description: Defines the HttpConnection class and its nested buffer management classes for handling HTTP connections, including read and write buffers, within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Represents an HTTP connection, managing socket, read/write buffers, and WebSocket association.

classes.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages the buffer for reading data from the socket, with capacity control and data management functions.

classes.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages the buffer for pending write data, supporting appending and consuming data.

methods.name: HttpConnection
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection with ID and socket.

methods.name: HttpConnection::SetWebSocket
methods.description: Associates a WebSocket with the connection.

methods.name: ReadIOBuffer::IncreaseCapacity
methods.description: Increases buffer capacity if within limit.

methods.name: ReadIOBuffer::StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer.

methods.name: ReadIOBuffer::DidRead
methods.description: Updates buffer after data is read.

methods.name: QueuedWriteIOBuffer::Append
methods.description: Appends data to write buffer if within size limit.

methods.name: QueuedWriteIOBuffer::GetSizeToWrite
methods.description: Returns size of data ready to be written.
